headline: Supreme Court Orders Karthigai Deepam Lighting In Tirupparankundram
seoTitle: Supreme Court Orders Karthigai Deepam Lighting in Tamil Nadu
metaDescription: The Supreme Court ordered CRPF to oversee the Karthigai Deepam lamp lighting at Tirupparankundram hill after reprimanding Tamil Nadu state authorities.
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court mandated the lighting of the ceremonial Karthigai Deepam lamp at Tirupparankundram hill.
CRPF personnel were deployed to oversee site security following the court's intervention in state administration.
The court issued contempt notices regarding the initial failure to facilitate the traditional lighting ceremony.
aiContextParagraph: The Supreme Court of India intervened in the administration of the Karthigai Deepam festival held at Tirupparankundram hill in Tamil Nadu. The court issued contempt notices to state officials after expressing dissatisfaction with the local government's initial handling of the ceremonial lamp lighting. To ensure compliance and manage security at the site, the Supreme Court directed the Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) to take control of the hill. The move has drawn attention from political figures, with the Bharatiya Janata Party criticizing the state government's approach to the religious event. While the state government was initially expected to cooperate with the judicial directives, the court eventually bypassed local oversight to guarantee the event proceeded. The site remains under federal security supervision as preparations for the traditional lamp lighting ceremony continue under the authority of the court's recent orders.
whyItIsViral: The story is widely covered by four independent media outlets due to the high-profile legal conflict between the Supreme Court and the state government over a religious festival.
